'''David Detlefs''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 36, from Bettendorf, IA. After Decipher's SWCCG run, the slot was marked Retired.<ref name="sm-fan" />

Known as "the Great Jawa", he became Gold 36 in January 1997 and started two gaming groups in Iowa.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
